propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) paginate through nextPageToken cursors but have no test exercising multiple pages, only single-page payloads with isLast=True
The cursor loop terminates on either isLast=True OR null/absent nextPageToken, but nothing asserts the cursor advances between requests, nor that termination conditions work in isolation or together

A repeated cursor token causes the readers to spin forever (byte-identical request and response, neither break condition fires) with fail-open exception handling converting the spin into a silently partial map
Transplanting the DC bug (break on short page) into Cloud's opaque-cursor loop is invisible to all existing assertions except a dedicated short-page oracle
AST guard over adapters/jira/*.py must verify any function POSTing to /rest/api/3/search/jql both loops and mentions nextPageToken, preventing unpaginated whole-project readers
